*Two issues to fix before merging:*

1. *Extension parsing breaks the documented contract* — `src/extension.js:2`
   It takes the segment after the first dot without lowercasing. Verified: `archive.tar.gz` and `photo.JPG` fall back to `application/octet-stream`, while `file.jpg.exe` incorrectly becomes `image/jpeg`. Dotless names return `undefined` instead of `''`.
   *Fix:* Extract the last extension, lowercase it, and return `''` for missing/trailing extensions.

2. *MIME lookup accepts inherited object properties* — `src/content-type.js:11`
   Unknown extensions such as `constructor` and `__proto__` return a function or object instead of the fallback MIME string.
   *Fix:* Use an own-property check, a null-prototype dictionary, or a `Map`.

All 3 existing tests pass, but `test/extension.test.js` only tests a simple lowercase extension, and there are no `contentType` tests covering these cases.

Reviewed `upload-extensions` at `a34d0a4` against `main`. No files changed.
